scenes.hook: H T M L Comments. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: H T M L comments are notes that browsers do not display as page content. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: A comment begins with an angle bracket, exclamation mark, and two hyphens.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw.
scenes.tip: It ends with two hyphens and a closing angle bracket. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Comments remain visible in source code, so never put secrets there.
scenes.try: Add a short comment explaining the next section of your page. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
